title: Text-Only Result Relay / Screenshot Evidence Removal
objective: Remove screenshot capture, screenshot persistence, screenshot-based relay evidence and attachment upload from the Brain-Work result relay workflow. Keep task assignment and result reporting text-native while preserving exact-once relay, restart safety and fail-closed semantics.

current_production_truth_until_execution.note: This authority record does not change live runtime behavior. The existing screenshot contract remains production truth until TASK-RBT-010 is implemented, qualified and deployed.

runtime: remove Work-result screenshot capture from relay preparation
replace result attachment send with the existing bounded text send path
remove screenshot_path dependency from new relay_inflight state
remove screenshot-file existence as a relay/rearm prerequisite
remove screenshot-specific cleanup/GC once no longer referenced
state_migration: preserve task_id, relay_id, response_digest, text_digest, retry/rearm state and target identity
migrate legacy relay_inflight records containing screenshot_path without destructive task reset
remove obsolete screenshot-only fields and artifacts after safe reconciliation
tests: replace screenshot/attachment contract tests with text-only exact-once relay tests
cover retry, rearm, restart, marker dedupe and legacy-latch migration
prove no duplicate relay and no screenshot dependency
documentation: update current Three-Lane architecture and README only when implementation is released

out_of_scope: clearing task or relay identity to force resend
clearing Chrome profile or ChatGPT login
changing unrelated screenshot capability if it is used outside result relay
definition_of_done: no Work-result screenshot is captured in the production relay path
no result screenshot is uploaded to Brain
new relay_inflight state has no screenshot_path dependency
legacy screenshot relay state migrates without duplicate relay or task reset
screenshot-specific EVIDENCE_MISSING branches are removed from active relay/rearm semantics
screenshot-specific lane-evidence GC is removed or proven unused
full result text remains the canonical Brain report payload
relay_id plus digests plus deterministic marker remain authoritative for exact-once delivery
full Supervisor CI and integrity gates pass
targeted production deployment passes with Brain/Work target fingerprint unchanged
live acceptance reports healthy Wrapper, Three-Lane, Chrome and CDP with no screenshot/attachment relay dependency
estimated_execution_window: 1.5-2 hours including implementation, regression updates, CI, targeted deployment and live acceptance
